newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Coffee expected to backtrack for now.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Coffee expected to backtrack for now.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE coffee futures need to retrace further to the downside before testing the upside again, analysts said on Friday.
July coffee was called to open between $30 and $40 a tonne lower after closing up $55 at $1,765 on Thursday.
September robustas were likely to run into resistance at $1,825, said independent technical analyst Elli Gifford.
She expected September to head back to support at $1,600, which was the base from which coffee rallied to 20-month highs last month.
But the view still lingered that coffee could move higher again in the longer term given the lack of definite signals that the overall bull run was finished.
"It still has an uptrend," Gifford said. "If it (September) holds $1,600 in a distinctly oversold background, it should attempt to go higher."
On the upside, September still had to complete a chart gap between the June 10 low of $1,850 and Thursday's high of $1,820.
